# The Grassy Issue

> An independent golf blog from Austin, Texas, edited by Lenny Harrington. It covers independent golf brands (197 in its Brand Index, each with its own page), gear edits with live prices, and Austin's public and municipal golf courses.

Every product price on the site is read from the brand's own store and dated. Coverage is editorial; some outbound links are affiliate links (see /disclosure).

## Start here
- [The Austin Golf Guide](https://thegrassyissue.com/field-guide): Austin's five municipal courses with green fees and booking rules, the best public courses, ranges, day trips, where to eat after the round, a tee-time cheat sheet and a season planner.
- [The Brand Index](https://thegrassyissue.com/brands): 197 golf brands and independent makers, each with its own page listing every Grassy Issue post that features it.
- [Our 25 Best Independent Golf Brands (2026)](https://thegrassyissue.com/brands/best-independent-golf-brands): Our 25 best independent golf brands for 2026, picked in Austin: founder-run labels making clothes, bags and headcovers, with three signature pieces from each.
- [About The Grassy Issue](https://thegrassyissue.com/about): Who runs the site, how products are chosen and how prices are checked.
